text:
Rina: spotting ~5% of inbound leads that never get claimed after enrichment completes. hubspot shows enrichment_ready=true but no owner change.
Carlos: thanks — I think RR router ignores leads with `manual_hold=true` and a legacy onboarding job set that flag for some older accounts.
Tasha (SDR): woke up to a bunch of default owners yesterday. it was confusing bc the lead card didn't say why.
ops-lee: short-term: we can add an HS workflow that clears `manual_hold` after enrichment_ack if `manual_hold_reason` == 'legacy_onboarding'. that'll free them for RR. long-term: add a reserve fallback pool and a separate TTL so leads don't bounce forever.
Rina: propose concrete steps: 1) HS backfill job to clear legacy holds for leads with enrichment_ready==true and manual_hold_reason==legacy_onboarding; 2) Router change: if enrichment_ready==true and claim fails 3 times, move lead to `inbound-reserve-night` or `inbound-reserve-day` based on company.timezone; 3) Add lead timeline event: "moved_to_reserve_pool" with reason and timestamp.
Carlos: implement claim counter as property `claim_attempts`. on each failed RR claim increment. after attempts>=3 set `reserve_pool=auto` and stop retries. Also set `reserve_ttl`=30m.
Tasha (SDR): Can reserve pool owners be a light duty group so SDRs know these are fallback assignments? also a tooltip on owner card would help.
sre-bot: Alert created: if percent_unclaimed_after_enrichment > 2% for 15m -> #marketing (rule RB-9110).
ops-lee: I'll push a canary: HS backfill + clear rule run once today, then feature-flag the router change for 2% traffic for 2h. metrics to watch: unclaimed_after_enrichment_pct, reserve_pool_count, duplicate_assignments.
Rina: add a tiny log we can grep: `[2026-05-10T02:13:01Z] lead=LP-9987 action=reserve_move reason=claim_fail attempts=3 tz=America/Los_Angeles`. include claim_attempts and reserve_ttl.
Carlos: i'll open PR with router guard and property increments. will add unit tests for not retrying when reserve_pool is set.
Tasha (SDR): UX followups: small banner in HS owner card "Assigned from reserve pool due to claim failures at <time>" and a link to explain.
Rina: timeline: canary in 2h. if stable, roll to 100% and add the playbook step. thanks all.
